rules.title: VAT = Net x rate on every line
rules.detail: 11 of 12 values are wrong, e.g. VAT of 'Headset' (row 5) is 0.00, expected 744.5872 (Net 3,918.88 x 19%; difference -744.5872); VAT of 'Label Printer' (Invoice!E6) evaluates to #VALUE!; VAT of 'Stapler' (row 7) is 362.53, expected 68.8807 (Net 362.53 x 19%; difference +293.6493). Exact amounts and amounts rounded to whole cents are both accepted.

rules.title: Gross = Net + VAT on every line
rules.detail: 11 of 12 values are wrong, e.g. Gross of 'Headset' (row 5) is 3,918.88, expected 4,663.4672 (Net 3,918.88 + VAT 744.5872; difference -744.5872); Gross of 'Label Printer' (Invoice!F6) evaluates to #VALUE!; Gross of 'Stapler' (row 7) is 725.06, expected 431.4107 (Net 362.53 + VAT 68.8807; difference +293.6493). Exact amounts and amounts rounded to whole cents are both accepted.

rules.title: Changing the rate in B1 updates VAT and Gross on every line and the totals
rules.detail: with B1 changed to 24% in a copy of the file, 24 of 27 values are wrong, e.g. VAT of 'Headset' (row 5) is 0.00, expected 940.5312 (Net 3,918.88 x 24%; difference -940.5312), the same as before the change; Gross of 'Headset' (row 5) is 3,918.88, expected 4,859.4112 (Net 3,918.88 + VAT 940.5312; difference -940.5312), the same as before the change; VAT of 'Label Printer' (Invoice!E6) evaluates to #VALUE!. Exact amounts and amounts rounded to whole cents are both accepted.

rules.title: When Qty and Unit Price change, VAT and Gross on every line and in the Total row follow the Nets
rules.detail: in a copy of the file where every line's Qty was raised by a different amount and every Unit Price by 1.00 (rate unchanged), 14 of 26 VAT and Gross figures (the lines and the Total row) did not follow the Nets: VAT of 'Headset' (row 5) is 0.00, expected 841.0806 (its Net in that copy 4,426.74 x 19%), the same as before the change; VAT of 'Label Printer' (Invoice!E6) evaluates to #VALUE!; Gross of 'Label Printer' (Invoice!F6) evaluates to #VALUE! (and 11 more). Exact amounts and amounts rounded to whole cents are both accepted.

rules.title: The Total row shows the correct Net, VAT and Gross totals
rules.detail: 2 of 3 values are wrong, e.g. Total VAT (Invoice!E16) evaluates to #VALUE!; Total Gross (Invoice!F16) evaluates to #VALUE!. Exact amounts and amounts rounded to whole cents are both accepted.

rules.title: Each line's Net still follows its Qty and Unit Price, and Total Net still follows the lines
Line items, quantities, prices and the rate are unchanged
